alice.yang: Heads up — after yesterday's RBAC flattening rollout in eu-west, we're seeing intermittent mTLS handshake failures between proxy-ng and model-svc. Started ~09:05 UTC. Logs show: 

alice.yang: ```
2026-03-22T09:05:18Z proxy-ng eu-west error: handshake failed: remote error: handshake failure (tls.ClientHello)
peer=10.4.23.54 svc=model-svc region=eu-west request_id=abc123
```

ben.patel: ugh. rolling RBAC change was the only thing pushed overnight right?

alice.yang: yep, RBAC + a keystore role rename. No cert rotations planned.

carmen: quick hypothesis: role rename prevented proxy from calling KMS/unwrap for intermediate certs. KMS unwrap denies show up?

alice.yang: checked KMS logs — I see a bunch of Deny events around the same time but the audit entries are missing correlation IDs. snippet: ```action=Decrypt deny principal=svc-account-proxy resource=projects/rdw/keyrings/keystore key=intermediate-key```

raj.srivastava: if proxy can't unwrap intermediate, it might present an incomplete chain and handshake fails. Also check OCSP stapling logs — I saw 502s on ocsp-cache around that window.

ben.patel: can we confirm whether the proxy still has access to the HSM key alias? RBAC rename could have removed the role binding.

alice.yang: running `gcloud iam roles list --filter="name:proxy-keystore*"` now, will share results.

sre-bot: deploybot: new rollout detected by canary-monitor: rbacs/proxy-keystore v2 -> 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Canary failure rate increased by 1.8x.

carmen: ok next steps: 1) snapshot current keystore state 2) rebind svc-account-proxy to keystore-decrypt role as emergency 3) correlate KMS deny events to request_ids and trace ids 4) add temporary fallback to cached intermediate chain in proxy

raj.srivastava: agree. also add a trace id to all unwrap requests so audit logs show correlation. That's been a gap.

ben.patel: if we rebind, can we do a scoped, time-limited binding and monitor? I don't want to open privilege long-term.

alice.yang: plan: do a 15m emergency rebind for svc-account-proxy -> roles/keystore.decrypt with TTL, watch canaries, then rotate back with a controlled script. I'll get org-iam to approve.

carmen: someone should also run `openssl s_client -connect model-svc.eu-west.internal:443 -showcerts` from proxy host to see the chain. If chain missing intermediate, that's our smoking gun.

alice.yang: attaching output from one proxy box: ```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = model-svc
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=model-svc
   i:/CN=rdw-intermediate
 1 s:/CN=rdw-intermediate
   i:/CN=rdw-root
```

ben.patel: chain looks fine on that box — but the proxy process may not have loaded the intermediate into the in-memory keystore because unwrap failed at startup.

raj.srivastava: are we seeing any evidence of cert TTL jitter? earlier we had a rotator job that staggered intermediate refresh times, could collide with role change.

alice.yang: rotator logs show intermediate refresh started at 09:01 and then got stuck waiting on unwrap. rotator retried 5x. snippet: ```unwrap error: access denied by policy (principal=svc-account-rotator)```

carmen: that matches. vuln-triage note: not a cryptographic vuln but an availability/regression due to IAM drift — mark SEV low-medium until service is degraded for >15m.

ben.patel: I've created a temporary binding and restarted proxy process on two canary hosts. Handshake failures dropped to near zero for those.

alice.yang: copying exact IAM command for rollback safety: ```gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding REDWOOD-PROD --member=serviceAccount:svc-account-proxy@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/keystore.decrypt --condition=None```

ben.patel: add audit annotation: `--message="emergency-rebind 15m reason=handshake-failures ticket=INC-7891"`

raj.srivastava: we should also harden logs: require request_id in KMS audit entries and ship unwrap/unwrap-response to secure-audit. Ops infra ticket to add trace header propagation: INFRA-4281.

carmen: longer term: 1) Make keystore unwraps resilient: fallback to cached intermediate chain 2) Add preflight IAM check during RBAC rollouts so any role rename runs a simulation of unwrap permissions in staging 3) Expand audit retention for KMS decrypt events to 90d for forensics

alice.yang: also enable a proxy fallback policy: if unwrap fails at startup, proxy should enter degraded mode but serve using cached chain for X minutes and alert SRE. That prevents hard failures during RBAC churn.

sre-bot: incident created: INC-7891 (mtls-handshake-eu-west) assigned to eng-security oncall.

ben.patel: action items assigned:
- ben: confirm all proxy instances rebound or queued for restart (done on canaries, rolling next)
- alice: org-iam approval for bounded rebind + revert script (in progress)
- raj: INFRA-4281 for trace propagation and audit improvements (created)
- carmen: write postmortem draft and include RBAC simulation checklist

alice.yang: will follow up in 30m with status. tagging @oncall-eng to keep eyes on canaries. :eyes:

raj.srivastava: one final ask — check cross-region fallback: if eu-west proxies can't serve, route to eu-central variant that has not yet been rotated. Add temporary routing policy in LB for the impacted subset.

alice.yang: noted. I'll open a routing rule change PR and hold it for 2i review.

carmen: thanks team. keep thread updates minimal but useful (one-line status or DONE).

alice.yang: 09:34 UTC — rebind in place for 15m, canaries healthy. continuing roll.

ben.patel: 09:45 UTC — rolling restart resumed, no new handshakes failing in last 10m.

incidents-bot: INC-7891 updated: severity=SEV3 -> monitoring. responders: alice.yang, ben.patel, carmen, raj.srivastava.

alice.yang: will file postmortem and remediation tasks. closing thread once postmortem queued.
